cell_audit.scope: Fig3B-G, FigS2B/C/D, Fig5E/F; additional to the four sheets audited in round4.
cell_audit.fig5_context: VPS34/PIK3C3 knockout is intentional and agrees between article and workbook, not a source-label error.
cell_audit.inference_limit: Imaging values do not supply biological donor counts or human force.

human_models: Curi p.L463S is a standalone patient line; its force trajectory varies with maturation and plate format.
Published Kora2025/2026 study supplies healthy/MTM1-knockout and patient p.E48*/gene-corrected pairs, not exact-BLU human force evidence.
Coriell fibroblasts offer distinct starting backgrounds; qualified muscle and use-compatible terms remain separate.
proof_corrections: Prior correction establishes disease causality; an intervention after the same deficit is needed to establish delayed modifiability.
Use a stable or predictable trajectory and baseline-adjusted useful function, not a required flat developmental trajectory.
Lower confidence bound should exceed both repeatability and minimum useful effect; crossing the useful threshold is inconclusive.
Equal-concentration culture comparisons measure intrinsic sensitivity; systemic interpretation requires relevant unbound tissue distribution.
Force transmission/geometry and intrinsic contractile physiology need separate interpretation.

PPCS.evidence: Distinct severe infant case reports rapid cardiac improvement after supplementation and normal measurements during continued follow-up; uncontrolled and concurrent-care confounded. Not a response-rate estimate or exhaustive case census.
larger_series_limits: One patient had cardiac recoveries before pantethine.
A treated post-arrest case also received cardiac medication and ICD; later asymptomatic VT is reported.
Force patches use two patient backgrounds, one clone each, with nonisogenic healthy controls.
Treatment during chamber maturation stabilized force without a significant increase.
Nominal100/500micromolar reagent and redox-containing medium do not establish oral myocardial exposure.
PPCS.disposition: Retain conditional reserve; preserve useful-preservation hypothesis separately from full reversal.

P2.contents: Axon-size figure and87 single-concentration assay rows; no animal-level efficacy dataset.
P2.correction: MAO-A59% is radioligand binding displacement. hERG-14% is binding, not electrophysiology. Nominal screening concentration divided by fusionEC50 is not universal selectivity or clinical safety.

Darier_comparator.root_read_scope: Primary English report design, analyses, outcome tables, safety, limitations; primary endpoint download independently matched hash.
Darier_comparator.status: Final-submitted CTIS results retain internal draft labels; not verified peer-reviewed clinical paper.
Darier_comparator.inference: Positive completer PGA/DLQI signal with selective nonresponse attrition, no control, retinoid confounding, no direct barrier result.
